review_unit: one frozen canonical unordered pair displayed as two neutrally rendered images
reviewer_question: Do these two images contain enough comparable visible evidence for a responsible individual-level comparison?
reason_rule: none_review_ready is permitted only with review_ready; not_review_ready and uncertain require one or more non-none reason codes.
technical_problem_rule: A technical problem is not a semantic outcome. The task remains unresolved and must be repaired or re-presented under an immutable incident record.
first_pass_rule: Every formal pair receives two independent first-pass judgements from two different registered people.
first_pass_disagreement_rule: Any exact disagreement among the three decision values triggers third-person adjudication.
adjudication_rule: The adjudicator did not first-pass that pair, sees the same neutral images, receives no prior response, and supplies a fresh blinded decision. That adjudication decision is the final three-category decision for the disagreed pair; all raw decisions remain immutable.
rendering_rule: Apply EXIF orientation, decode to RGB, preserve the full oriented pixel dimensions, write lossless PNG with metadata removed, and perform no crop, resize, enhancement, denoising, sharpening, or content edit.
asset_token_scope: opaque token is scoped to reviewer code and source image; tokens differ across reviewer packages
first_pass_interface_prohibitions: descriptor names, scores, ranks, or memberships
sampling stage, stratum, cell, or inclusion probability
search, sort, filter, bulk download, or hidden metadata controls
release_gates: actual opaque codes map to distinct accountable people in a restricted roster
every pair has two distinct first-pass people
every pair has at least one eligible third person
static field and asset audit passes
independent non-reviewer real-browser leakage audit passes
